_comment: Drives compare.html. Third-party samples under models/<dataset>/ are NOT CadQuarry data and NOT CC0 — each retains its origin dataset's / author's license. See THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md. A dataset with status 'hosted' renders a live 3D grid from its models/<dataset>/index.json; 'linkout' shows an info card only (gated or mesh-less sources).

cadquarry.name: CadQuarry
cadquarry.parametric: Yes — every part is a PARAMS schema + build(p) function
cadquarry.provenance: Generated from scratch, reproducible bit-for-bit from a seed
cadquarry.redistributable: Yes — public domain, no attribution required

datasets.name: ABC Dataset
datasets.parametric: No — B-rep solids only, no parametric program
datasets.redistributable: Inconsistent — each model keeps its original Onshape author license
datasets.note: Sample of OBJ meshes from official chunk 0, converted to STL for display. There is no single dataset-wide license: each model retains whatever license its original Onshape author chose.

datasets.name: Fusion 360 Gallery
datasets.provenance: User designs from the Autodesk Online Gallery
datasets.redistributable: No — Autodesk research license restricts redistribution
datasets.note: Sample STL meshes via a public HF mirror. Upstream Autodesk terms are research-only; shown here for comparison.

datasets.name: Thingi10K
datasets.redistributable: Per-model: a mix of CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND and all-rights-reserved
datasets.note: Sample STL meshes via the official HF dataset. Each model carries its own Thingiverse license (trace by id at thingiverse.com/thing:<id>); check before any reuse.

datasets.name: DeepCAD
datasets.parametric: Construction sequences (sketch + extrude commands), not free-parameter schemas
datasets.redistributable: Code is MIT; the underlying geometry inherits ABC/Onshape provenance
datasets.reason: DeepCAD is distributed as CAD command-sequences, not meshes — its geometry is a curated subset of ABC (shown above). Producing meshes needs running its reconstruction pipeline.
datasets.note: The MIT license covers the modeling/learning code; the shapes come from ABC.

datasets.name: ShapeNet
datasets.redistributable: No — terms require registration and forbid re-hosting
datasets.reason: ShapeNet's surface meshes sit behind a signed-agreement login; the only ungated mirrors are point clouds / SDFs / renders, not meshes. Bandwidth doesn't help — it's a gating restriction.
datasets.note: To include it, download under your own ShapeNet account and drop the OBJs into models/shapenet/.
